title: What If We Brought Back the Dire Wolf? A Company Says It Did in 2025

scenes.text: What if the dire wolf came back? In 2025 a company said it had. Scientists disagreed.
Colossal Biosciences took DNA from a 13,000-year-old tooth and a 72,000-year-old bone.
They made 20 edits to the grey wolf genome, cloned the cells, and dog surrogates carried three pups: Romulus, Remus and Khaleesi.
The pups are larger, with thick pale coats. They live on a 2,000-acre preserve with a 10-person care staff.
But dire wolves split from grey wolves nearly 5.7 million years ago. Critics called the pups grey wolf clones with cosmetic edits.
So what came back is a new animal that looks like an old one. The real dire wolf is still extinct. Would you count it?

description:
What if we brought back the dire wolf? In April 2025 Colossal Biosciences announced three pups, Romulus, Remus and Khaleesi, made with 20 edits to the grey wolf genome, guided by DNA from a 13,000-year-old tooth and a 72,000-year-old bone, and carried by dog surrogates.
Critics point out that dire wolves and grey wolves diverged nearly 5.7 million years ago, so the pups are grey wolves with a handful of edits rather than a resurrected species.
What should we run through next?
